title: SOUTHCOM: tic tac detected by space asset near a naval vessel

tellings.quote: Southcom southern command tic tac detected by space asset in proximity of vessel.

plain: Somewhere at sea in the area covered by Southern Command, the US military command responsible for Central and South America, a "tic tac", a white oval object shaped like the mint, was reportedly picked up by a sensor in space close to a Navy ship. Michels reads the line himself from a report called Immaculate Constellation, which comes through Matthew Brown, described in the episode as a Pentagon whistleblower: "tic tac detected by space asset in proximity of vessel." If true, it would mean the military tracked such objects from space as well as from ships and planes.
